results.title: Nasa scientists grew corn seeds in space and found something strange: How microgravity confused roots & shoots that normally know exactly which way to grow
results.description: Nasa scientists grew corn seeds in space: NASA conducted an intriguing experiment on corn seeds grown in the absence of gravity’s guiding force. Other plants, including Arabidopsis, have also shown unusual growth patterns in microgravity.
